gloss_en: Scottish physicist whose equations unified electricity and magnetism and who recognized the electromagnetic nature of light (1831-1879)
senses_vi: J. C. Maxwell (nhà vật lý Scotland, 1831-1879)

gloss_en: United States geneticist who published the complete base sequences for all the genes of a free-living organism, the influenza bacterium; later led team that developed a first draft of the entire human genome (born in 1946)
senses_vi: J. Craig Venter (nhà di truyền học người Mỹ)
